recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it is a narrow correction to the approved source example and avoids misleading implementers with invalid XML in the scenario the issue was meant to clarify.
issue_request: FHIR-33256 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core clarification asking for documentation and examples showing how to add extensions with FHIRPath Patch; the resolution called for test cases and specification examples.
initial_application: Commit 147147842e3fd0e1fce396e212dead752d91869c added an Extension Example section to source/fhirpatch.html for FHIR-33256. The page is active through source/hierarchy.xml and linked from HTTP PATCH guidance.
additional_context: The linked Zulip discussion shows the intended nested-part representation, full extension URL, and preferred extension ordering. The FHIRPath Patch profile requires operation type to be valueCode, and FHIR XML encodes Reference.reference as a nested reference element with a value attribute.
reconciliation: Changed source/fhirpatch.html to mark the extension snippets as XML, use valueCode for the add operation, place the extension part before description/time, and encode both Reference examples as <reference value="Device/1"/>.
source_changes: source/fhirpatch.html: corrected the FHIRPath Patch extension example's code type, XML class, nested Reference encoding, and extension child ordering.
